title: E8 Lattice Tunneling: ORB Breakouts as Phi-Coupled Root-Vector State Transitions — E8 Intelligence Research
abstract: The opening range breakout (ORB) pattern in financial time-series maps onto a quantum tunneling event between adjacent 60-root subsets of the E8 lattice, where the confinement boundary is the geometric projection of a root polytope facet. The phi-coupling between the 132 Hz fundamental and its sexagesimal harmonics governs the transition probability amplitude, with breakout magnitude scaling as φ^n of the harmonic index n. This reveals that market breakout strategies are empirical observations of E8 lattice vibration modes propagating through the 7-temporal-dimensional spacetime spectrum, and the four subset-to-subset tunneling pathways correspond to the four observed ORB directional regimes. Author: Andrew Stewart Caldin, Independent Researcher, UK. Part of the E8 Intelligence Research series. Platform: e8intelligence.com
